_comment: Human visual-review verdicts per domain (worst→best: critical/flaw/clean, plus 'blocked' for domains with no capture to review — hard 403 / bot wall), kept separate from auto-scored *--score.json so re-running the sweep never overwrites them. The gallery merges these and can sort by verdict. Notes describe the CURRENT state only (no fix history). Update after eyeballing a re-captured clip/cast.
